metadata.title: eFa-next 6.0.0.6.7: compliance file
metadata.remarks:
Not a legally binding statement. This file lists which technical requirements of the standards eFa-next covers, how far, and how each claim can be checked. It is no certification, no confirmation of conformity by a third party and no legal advice. Warranty and liability: DISCLAIMER.md applies, to the maximum extent permitted by law. The operator stays responsible for the conformity of their organisation. Anyone can have this information verified independently at any time by auditors of their own choice, with: the SHA-256 of this file in the signed SHA256SUMS of the release, "efactl compliance-verify" on an installed host, and the open source code (AGPL-3.0).

Keine rechtlich verbindliche Aussage. Diese Datei listet, welche technischen Anforderungen der Standards eFa-next abdeckt, in welchem Umfang und wie jede Angabe geprüft werden kann. Sie ist keine Zertifizierung, keine Konformitätsbestätigung durch Dritte und keine Rechtsberatung. Gewährleistung und Haftung: Es gilt DISCLAIMER.md, soweit gesetzlich zulässig. Der Betreiber bleibt für die Konformität seiner Organisation verantwortlich. Eine unabhängige Überprüfung durch eigene Prüfer oder Auditoren ist jederzeit möglich, mit: der SHA-256-Prüfsumme dieser Datei in der signierten SHA256SUMS des Release, "efactl compliance-verify" auf einem installierten Host und dem offenen Quellcode (AGPL-3.0).

components.title: eFa-next
components.description: Self-hosted open source mail security gateway (AGPL-3.0).

control-implementations.description: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) (2016/679). Always for an operator in the EU or for mail of people in the EU. The operator is the controller.

implemented-requirements.description: Data minimisation: No mail content in logs; subjects only for permitted roles; pseudonyms in the mail log; header privacy outbound.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Pseudonyms after 14 days only on new installs; an upgrade keeps the old setting.

implemented-requirements.description: Storage limitation: Retention days per kind of data and tenant, nightly purge with an audit entry.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Backups keep data up to their own age.

implemented-requirements.description: Right of access: gdpr-export of everything about one mail address.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Accounts and sender lists are named, not exported in full.

implemented-requirements.description: Right to erasure: gdpr-delete of one mail address: mail log rows, stored headers, held mail, spam reports and mail relations; when asked its accounts and its entries of the sender lists. Audited with a pseudonym and the reason; every erasure goes into an erasure list (pseudonyms only, outside the backups) that a restore applies again.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Backups stay as they are (signed) for up to 5 days; logs of the operating system and mail already delivered to the mailbox are outside eFa-next.

implemented-requirements.description: Data protection by design and by default: New features are off after an update; private defaults on new installs.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Defaults of an upgraded host stay as they were.

implemented-requirements.description: Processor: A template for the data processing agreement; tenants separated in rights.
implemented-requirements.remarks: The template is not reviewed by a lawyer; the contract is the operator's.

implemented-requirements.description: Records of processing activities: privacy-evidence builds the record of processing and the TOM from the settings in effect.
implemented-requirements.remarks: The record stays the operator's document.

implemented-requirements.description: Security of processing: TLS profiles, 2FA and passkeys, login lockout, signed and encrypted backups, audit chain with signed anchors, SELinux and service sandboxes.
